---
title: "🗓️ Week 9  - Getting to know NISAR data"
---

The NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite mission provides high-resolution, dual-band (L-band and S-band) radar data to map Earth's land, ice, and ecosystems. Launched on July 30, 2025, it captures global observations every 12 days through open-access portals like the Alaska Satellite Facility.
